sql_query:
SELECT
  LEFT(oi.product_id, 10) AS product_id,
  COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') AS product_name,
  SUM(oi.order_item_id) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation AS pct
  ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
GROUP BY
  LEFT(oi.product_id, 10),
  COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY
  total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 3;
